component.name: ASR Pipeline Profiler
component.summary: Per-stage CPU, GPU, memory and junctions for local speech pipelines

description.p: Profiles a multi-model local speech-to-text pipeline (voice activity detection, ASR, paragraph or punctuation models, post-processing) as a whole: how long each model call takes, how much CPU and how many threads each stage really uses, memory per model, GPU use, and the junctions, the gaps between one stage finishing and the next starting.
Read a built-in sample aloud or open a recording, run it in batch or real-time replay, and read the result as a timeline and tables. Also a command-line tool and an HTTP server.
